# HookTos AI

HookTos AI helps creators develop short-form social video content. Its content-generation workflow provides ten hook ideas, a retention score, an SEO description, and fifteen hashtags for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.hooktos.com/): HookTos AI content generation overview.
- [Blog](https://www.hooktos.com/blog): Guides and strategies for short-form content.
